# /fc:ba

[← Back to commands](../commands.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js from commands/ba.md; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/ba.md instead. -->

> **Shortcut.** Runs [`/fc:analyse`](analyse.md) under a shorter name.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:ba` |
| Codex name | `$fc-ba` |
| Kind | Project task — loads `ai-factory/tasks/analyse.md` from your repo, so it needs an adopted workspace |
| Description | Shortcut for /fc:analyse — Turn a feature description into a business-analysis pack — objectives, scope, actors and permissions, use cases, requirements, rules, data, stories with acceptance criteria, test scenarios — facts, assumptions and open questions kept apart; before any spec |
| Arguments | `<feature description> \| lean\|questions <feature description> \| review\|update\|explain <analysis path> […]` |

## Usage

**Shortcut.** `/fc:ba` is a shorter name for [`/fc:analyse`](analyse.md): the same task, not a
deprecated one. It runs the analyse task with the same input, takes the same arguments and modes,
and writes what `/fc:analyse` writes. It shows no notice. Codex has `$fc-ba`, and headless
`TASK=ba` runs the analyse task too. To pin a model, map `analyse` in `ai-factory/models.yaml`.
